SELECT pp.id, pd.sku_no, pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url,
FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.product_id = #{productId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc

SELECT pp.id, pd.sku_no, pd.id AS sku_id, pd.images_url,
FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.id = #{skuId} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pd.id desc

SELECT pd.id AS skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.images_url as imageUrl, pd.name as productName, pd.variant_property variantProperty, pp.ean as eanNo FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd.id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted = FALSE and pd.id = #{skuId}

SELECT pd.id AS skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.images_url as imageUrl, pi.name as productName, pd.status as status, pd.variant_property variantProperty, pp.ean as eanNo FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd.id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted = FALSE and (pd.sku_no = #{params.searchKeyword} or pp.ean = #{params.searchKeyword})
and pd.status = #{params.status}
